fixer.title: agentHost: route offered client tools before replacement settles

introducer.title: agentHost: update client tools without restarting sessions

cases.mechanism: A newly offered client-tool handler could park a DeferredPromise in PendingRequestRegistry during the asynchronous setTools boundary while routing still reflected only the old snapshot. Because the emitted start lacked a client contributor, no client response resolved it, blocking the tool invocation and turn indefinitely and retaining the pending entry until session cleanup.
cases.symptom: A client tool invoked in the narrow setTools acceptance window could hang the active agent turn indefinitely, with one pending deferred retained per affected invocation until the session ended.
cases.fixedBehavior: The fix stages the union of applied/offered client names and the offered definitions before awaiting replaceTools, so an invocation started by the runtime during that boundary is attributed to the providing client and its pending handler receives a completion; rejection restores the prior routing.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, updateClientTools awaited configuration.replaceTools/session.setTools at line 3695 before updating _clientToolNames and _appliedSnapshot. The runtime can invoke a newly supplied Tool handler while setTools is still pending: the handler calls _pendingClientToolCalls.register(toolCallId), while tool.execution_start attribution uses _clientToolNames and _appliedSnapshot through _getToolCallContributor/_resolveClientToolOwner. With the old post-await state, the start had no client contributor, so no client completion was produced and the PendingRequestRegistry entry remained parked until session teardown. The changed test exercises exactly this ordering and awaits the handler before releasing the setTools gate.
